column1: # Seed routes for SEED_ROUTES: issns<TAB>layer<TAB>config-json. ISSNs comma separated (print and electronic
# where known); a journal is matched by any of them, and an ISSN no registered journal has is skipped.
# Checked 2026-11-19: the Pensoft sets from https://zookeys.pensoft.net/oai.php?verb=ListSets (103 sets, oai_dc
# and mods only), their ISSNs from OpenAlex; sets without an ISSN (books, preprints) or with an uncertain one are
# left out. MNHN (sciencepress.mnhn.fr) is left out too: one endpoint for all its journals, without sets or any
# journal field in the records, so a route per journal cannot tell its records apart.
